tool.name: qiime2 sidle reconstruct-taxonomy
tool.description: Reconstructs taxonomic strings for a reconstructed sidle table.
tool.command: export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="\$PWD/xdgconfig" MPLCONFIGDIR="\$PWD/mplconfigdir" NUMBA_CACHE_DIR="\$PWD/numbacache" CONDA_PREFIX=/opt/conda/envs/sidle-0.1.0-beta && q2galaxy run sidle reconstruct_taxonomy '$inputs'

param.name: reconstruction_map
param.label: Reconstruction map
param.help: [required] A map between the final kmer name and the original database sequence. Useful for reconstructing taxonomy and trees.

param.name: taxonomy
param.label: Reference taxonomy
param.help: [required] The taxonomic strings from the database.

param.name: database
param.label: Reference database
param.help: [default: 'none'] The taxonomic database being used. Currently, the only two supported databases are Greengenes and Silva. The database choice influences the handling of missing and ambiguous taxa.

param.name: define_missing
param.label: Define missing
param.help: [default: 'merge'] Taxonomic strings may be missing information (for example `g__` in greengenes or `D_5__uncultured bacteria` in Silva). These can be ignored (`"ignore"`) and treated like any other taxonomic designation; they can be first inherited in merged sequences (`"merge"`), where, when there are two strings being merged and one has a missing level, the missing level is taken form the defined one, or they can be inherited from the previous level (`"inherit"`) first, and then merged.

param.name: ambiguity_handling
param.label: Ambiguity handling
param.help: [default: 'ignore'] whether "ambiguous taxa" (Silva-specific) should be treated as missing values (`"missing"`) or ignored (`"ignore"`).

tool.help:
QIIME 2: sidle reconstruct-taxonomy =================================== Reconstructs taxonomic strings for a reconstructed sidle table.
Outputs: -------- :reconstructed_taxonomy.qza: Taxonomy which addresses the ambiguity in assignment associated with mapping to multiple sequences in reconstruction.
|
Description: ------------ Reconstructs the taxonomic annotation based on a sidle database by identifying the lowest taxonomic level where the taxonomic annotation diverges for two sequences.
|
